title_zh: three.js 许可正本与随包构建溯源（MIT，随包收录）
title_en: three.js licence text and vendored-build provenance (MIT, shipped in package)
note_zh: license_text 为 three.js 官方 LICENSE 逐字全文（MIT 要求再分发时附带版权声明与许可原文），按行拆分承载；以换行符连接 license_text 数组即可逐字节重建原文，重建后 SHA-256 应等于 plain_text_sha256。
note_en: license_text carries the official three.js LICENSE verbatim (MIT requires the copyright notice and licence text to travel with redistributions), split by line; joining the array with newline characters rebuilds the original byte-for-byte, whose SHA-256 must equal plain_text_sha256.
transformation_zh: 为使页面在 file:// 下无需 ES 模块即可运行，本包将官方 module 构建机械重封装为单文件 IIFE：（1）在文件头部加一段许可与溯源注释；（2）将上游 module 主体逐字节放入 (function(){"use strict"; … })() 中；ES 模块本就是严格模式，因此 "use strict" 保持语义一致；（3）将全文唯一一条末尾 export{local as Exported, …} 语句（唯一被删除的语句）替换为等价的命名空间对象，赋给 globalThis.THREE 与 window.THREE。上游其余字节未做任何修改，导出名 416 个全部保留。
transformation_en: To let the page run from file:// without ES modules, the official module build is mechanically repackaged into a single-file IIFE: (1) a licence and provenance comment is prepended; (2) the upstream module body is placed verbatim inside (function(){"use strict"; … })() -- ES modules are always strict, so "use strict" preserves semantics; (3) the single trailing export{local as Exported, …} statement, the only statement removed, is replaced by the equivalent namespace object assigned to globalThis.THREE and window.THREE. No other upstream byte is modified and all 416 exported names are preserved.
network_behaviour_zh: 本包内使用不发起任何网络请求：仅使用 WebGLRenderer、几何与材质、本地 Canvas 纹理；不使用任何 Loader、不加载远程模型、贴图、字体或统计代码。
network_behaviour_en: No network request is made from this package: only WebGLRenderer, geometry and material classes and locally drawn canvas textures are used; no loader, remote model, texture, font or analytics code is involved.
